sentences.en: Subtle differences in tone discriminate the original from the copy.
sentences.zh: 细微的音调差异区分了原件和复制品。

sentences.en: He made a speech using his unique tone of voice.
sentences.zh: 他用自己独特的嗓音发表了演讲。

sentences.en: His tone lead me to think that he already knew.
sentences.zh: 他的语气让我觉得他已经知道了。

senses.zh: 音，腔调，声调，音调，语气，品质，色调
使更健壮，装腔作势地说，定调，调色
